name: botwatcher-dashboard
description: Desktop app Electron + React + Playwright untuk memantau Obrolan yang perlu dijawab Facebook Marketplace.

scripts.gui:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.build:win: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:playwright-browsers && npx --yes electron-builder@26.15.7 --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:playwright-browsers: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=./playwright-browsers pnpm exec patchright install chromium
